item.title: Funny, if only
item.description: Anthropic’s initial public offering was the biggest in history. But the bumpy ride for tech stocks continues, as does political controversy over the AI industry. Paul Demarty investigates the bubble

item.title: If loving you is Huang …
item.description: The underlying dynamic, of dividing the world into great-power blocs pending great-power war, has been drastically reinforced by - of all things - the sexual exploits of a middle-aged, leather-jacketed nerd. Harley Filben looks at Nvidia and its strategic importance
item.dc:creator: Paul Demarty
